'''Yuri Stonelaw''' was a resident of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vernet]]. He was the son of [[Arn Stonelaw|Arn]] and [[Emmi Stonelaw]], the brother of [[Kristoff Stonelaw|Kristoff]], and the foster brother of [[Mair Koda]]. After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] arrived on Vernet and conscripted Kristoff, Yuri resolved to rescue him. Enlisting Koda's help when she returned to Vernet after a trading run, the pair infiltrated the [[Vernet Imperial Army Training Camp|Imperial base]] and tried to rescue their brother. However, Kristoff was indoctrinated by the Empire and unwilling to leave, forcing Yuri and Koda to flee the planet.<ref name="TD" />
